meta.name: Pottery of ancient Italy, one vessel of each form per period
meta.description: Vessels of continental Italy from the Early Bronze Age to the Archaic period (2300–480 BC), each turned from its drawn section at its real size. Handles and decoration are not in the data: the profiles were drawn without them. Materials follow each vessel's ware as AIPPD records it; the decoration illustrates its period's styles, not the vessel's own.
meta.source: AIPPD, Ancient Italy Pottery Profiles Dataset v0.1 (Cardarelli 2024, Appendix A), doi:10.5281/zenodo.24249544, Apache License 2.0
meta.book: Cardarelli, L. 2024. Morphological variability and standardisation of vessel shapes in the 2nd and first half of the 1st millennium BC in continental Italy. Adrias 18. Bari: Edipuglia. doi:10.4475/0840
